why_budget_pass_alone_fails.summary: On hires-ramped-n96 Dense arm, both rtol=1e-4 and rtol=1e-8 PASS v3 B=10.0 (dense_case_wrms=0.3922 and 0.4093), yet their actual anchor-scale achieved WRMS errors are 3922.1 vs 0.4093 (9583x apart) with dense JVP cost 4964 vs 22518 (4.54x).

frozen_admissibility_order: 1. GridAndInitialConditionIdentity: bit-identical requested_times (grid_sha256) and identical y0, t_span, breakpoints.

2. ReferenceAuthorityGate: reference_uncertainty_wrms = richardson + method_disagreement <= 0.1 * E_achieved (ReferenceDominance::Admissible). ReferenceDominated points are inadmissible for ranking tighter targets.

3. OutputPolicyAndInterpolantGate: primary ranking uses dense output on natural macro-steps (no forced output-grid step clipping); requires same-step interpolant_delta <= 2.0 (two-arm-output-admissibility-v3) and records legacy v2 gap for continuity.

4. ComparatorFidelityGate: cross-method performance ranking requires comparator_fidelity == 'production' on all compared arms; any participation by 'reference-implementation-only' comparators forces comparative_reading = 'forbidden'.

5. DerivativePermissionAndTransactionGate: derivative class (RHS-only, JVP, explicit Jacobian, FD) must be declared and enforced fail-closed; rejected attempts must leave accepted state bit-identical and charge 100% of speculative work.

matched_achieved_error_protocol.target_quantity: Achieved global output error E on the frozen common output grid: conservative_max_wrms = max_grid_wrms + reference_uncertainty_wrms (or problem-family exact max_grid_l2 where exact analytic solution exists).
matched_achieved_error_protocol.sweep_requirement: Evaluate >= 4 tolerance settings (or fixed step sizes where method is fixed-step) per solver to map its monotone Pareto error-cost frontier (E_k, W_k).
matched_achieved_error_protocol.overlapping_interval_rule: Given two admissible frontiers A and B, define achieved-error ranges [E_min^A, E_max^A] and [E_min^B, E_max^B]. Matched-error comparisons are strictly confined to I_{A,B} = [max(E_min^A, E_min^B), min(E_max^A, E_max^B)]. If max > min, report NOT_COMPARABLE_NO_OVERLAP; extrapolation outside empirical range is forbidden.
cost_evaluation_at_target_E_star: Discrete attainment (repository select_cheapest_below_target): minimum cost among admissible runs satisfying E <= E*.

Log-log continuous interpolation: for adjacent Pareto frontier points (E_0, C_0) and (E_1, C_1) bracketing E_0 <= E* <= E_1 inside I_{A,B}, compute C(E*) = exp(log(C_0) + (log(E*) - log(E_0)) / (log(E_1) - log(E_0)) * (log(C_1) - log(C_0))).

empirical_fixed_pareto_illustration_PR_l.note: Fixed-step demonstration only; comparative reading remains 'forbidden' because radau-iia3-fixed carries comparator_fidelity='reference-implementation-only'.

required_separate_buckets: setup_work (pre-integration operator/bound/tableau setup time and calls)
startup_work (starter Newton solves/iterations/LU/RHS before step 1, e.g. ppsw1::start Radau IIA vs zero-Newton stepping)
accepted_step_work (RHS, batch RHS, ft, Jacobian builds, direct LU, direct solves, JVP calls/vectors)
rejected_step_work (charged into WorkCounters and also exposed independently via rejected_steps / failure counters)
fallback_step_work (fallback_steps and all fallback linear/direct calls)
memory_footprint (stored_state_bytes on output grid vs actual Linux process peak RSS VmHWM in KiB per isolated run)
complete_work_and_memory_accounting.wall_time_authority_rule: Unpaired/single-run wall times MUST carry timing_authority='diagnostic_only'. Authoritative wall-time ratios require paired randomized interleaved TimingProtocol (>=2 warmups, >=7 repetitions) on identical hardware.
